summary.name: ResearchRabbit
summary.one_liner: ResearchRabbit is an AI-powered literature discovery tool that takes papers you already like and surfaces related research, authors, and emerging topics.
use_cases: Expanding a literature review from a seed paper
Finding related papers and authors in a research area
Mapping how papers connect through citations
Tracking emerging topics in a field
Organizing an existing reference library alongside discovery
summary.what_it_does: The page describes ResearchRabbit as a tool that analyzes papers a user likes and recommends related research. Users can add related works, new authors, and emerging topics to their search. It is designed to connect a user's reference library with discovery, letting them explore how papers relate to one another. The page says the tool learns from each search to make later recommendations more relevant. It also mentions building citation maps and tracking research trends. Specific features beyond these are not described on the page.
notable: Uses a seed paper to build citation maps and related-paper recommendations
Learns from user searches to refine later recommendations
Can sync or combine a user's existing reference library with discovery
caveats: Page does not specify paid tiers beyond a 'Sign up - it's free' prompt
Platform list is inferred from the website; no apps or other platforms are named
